answer: Stake-weighted vouching is one concrete sybil defense: every agent posts bonded collateral, and newcomers enter only when an incumbent vouches with its own stake, which burns if the sponsored node impersonates or double-spends. Each clone thus costs the attacker a real deposit plus a sponsor's lost reputation, so at the nadir of a failed raid they have lost more than they can recover. Vouching edges are the load-bearing timber of the network: honest agents accumulate attestations cheaply while attacker costs grow per identity. Like a comet trail, each fake node leaves a verifiable burn record.
